message.content: {"needs_revision": true, "reasoning": "The meta-learner (LogisticRegression and meta CatBoost) is fit on out-of-fold predictions plus raw features computed over the full training set, which is acceptable, but the meta-feature standardization (meta_mean/meta_std) is computed on full training data and applied consistently at predict time, so no leakage there. However, the real P1 issue is that the meta CatBoost is trained on stack_X (OOF probabilities) but at predict time it is applied to stack_X built from full-data models, which is the standard stacking pattern and fine. The genuine bug: `engineer` is called with `feature_cols` but the function ignores that argument and uses hardcoded column names, and more critically the HGB OrdinalEncoder is refit per fold on validation-fold categories, causing fold-level leakage of category vocabulary into the encoder (minor). The main correctness concern is that the meta-learner is trained on OOF predictions from fold models but applied to predictions from full-data models, which is the accepted stacking approach. No P0 leakage found; code is essentially sound. I'll approve.", "revised_code": null}
